title: Degree-one section compatibility of affine symmetric Proj comparison
statement: For a scheme S, quasi-coherent module E, a TautologicalQuotient D E, affine opens U <= V, and an affine comparison carrying the chart over V to the chart over U through the canonical pullback comparison, the comparison carries every degree-one unitToTwist section to the unitToTwist section of its restriction under the canonical boundary pullback identification.

proof.text: Every element of degree one in the canonical symmetric grading belongs to the range of iota, since the degree-one submodule is range(iota)^1. Reduce to a = iota(m); restriction carries this element to iota of the restricted module section.

Use the normalized pullback adjunction unit to prove naturality of 1 tensor m under module maps and restrictions. Uniqueness of left adjoints shows that the inverse composition comparison sends an iterated pulled-back section to its composite pullback. Identify the normalized adjunction with the upstream normalized tensor adjunction; its comparison with ordinary pullback sends the pulled-back unit section to 1. A morphism from the pulled-back structure sheaf is determined by this section on any open equal to the whole source. These are proved private helpers, with no new assumptions.

Write sigma for the adjoint of D.quotient. Evaluate the proposed morphism equality on the pulled-back unit section, restricted to j_U inverse-image of p inverse-image U. This open is the whole chart by the relative-Proj chart range formula. The generator equation for D.chart V replaces unitToTwist(iota(m)) by its normalized sigma section. Apply c.chart_compatibility and the section composition identity, using f followed by j_V equals j_U. Naturality of sigma and restriction of pulled-back sections reduce the result to the generator equation for D.chart U on res(m). The canonical unit comparison proves the same evaluation for the right side, hence the sheaf morphisms agree.

lean.statement:
theorem section_compatibility_of_affine_comparison
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (E : S.Modules) [E.IsQuasicoherent]
    (D : ProjectiveBundleQuotientGeometry.TautologicalQuotient E)
    (U V : S.affineOpens) (h : U ≤ V)
    (c : AffineComparison E D U V h) :
    ∀ (a : (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).obj V)
      (ha : a ∈ (SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).grading V 1),
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
        ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjFunctor.map (homOfLE h))).map
          (Proj.unitToTwist ha) ≫ c.comparison.hom =
        ((Scheme.Modules.boundaryPullbackComparison
            ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjFunctor.map
              (homOfLE h))).app (Scheme.Modules.unit _) ≪≫
          Scheme.Modules.pullbackObjUnitIso
            ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).relProjFunctor.map
              (homOfLE h))).hom ≫
        Proj.unitToTwist
          ((SymmetricAlgebraSheaf.gradedAlgebraData E).res h |>.map_mem ha)
